comments.quote: The hotel is of great quality with a lovely Chinese-style decor, and it's very clean. I especially loved their bathtub, from which you can see a bamboo forest. The transportation is also very convenient. Breakfast is served as individual portions...
comments.author: Nuoyaya

comments.quote: Incredibly kind and considerate staff. Was willing to answer all questions and concerns. If your looking for some time away in the mountains and some peace and quiet would definitely recommend!

comments.quote: Great little Boutique Hotel . The breakfast with homemade delicacies was excellent. The room very nicely designed. A very quiet and remote getaway
